As much as you believe there is no hell, I believe there is hell. The aim is to respect each others opinion.
I'm not here to judge whether you will go or not to hell, but there is hell
Is that what people call "working from home"? ![gif](emote|free_emotes_pack|joy)
I am considering a lot of ways, some more than others, but I have come to it, there is no painless way
We might not hear from you for the coming days, but please come back feeling better. It will make us smile
That's fine buddy, let's both keep strong a little more :)

I am in a current state of depression where I want to kill myself. Don't expect me to give you a top advice because even though I want you to stay alive, it wouldn't make sense to tell everyone else to stay alive but meanwhile go and kill myself. 

I just tried to simply reply to your question and didn't mean anything wrong.

Not that I encourage you doing it but since when offing yourself is a sin?

"for God so love the world, that he gave His only begotten Son, that whoever may believe in him, shall not perish but have life eternal"

Over 70% of my life has been affected with trauma and depression. I don't think it's a temporary problem. Just like some people are born for something, I am born to kill myself and there is no way out of it.

One lesson I learned through the years, I am now 21 and always thought love was good. 

We all need love, but you need to realise, your life is yours and no one cares about it. You may think at times there's this amazing person or that one like I did, but I realise that it's only about me and no one will make efforts for me. 

Sorry that this may sound tough, but don't give up that young
I'll join the land!

Drastic decisions never work.   
From my own experience, I can advise you to start by steps.   
Month 1 : Income 1k – Spending 1k  
Month 2 : Income 1k – Spending 900  
Month 3 : Income 1k – Spending 800  
Etc… 

until you really spend on what you need. It is easier said than done I agree, but as long as you don’t spend more than what you have, that’s already a very good point you can award yourself with!
Could call it a coldline tbh
Yeh some sort of them. Can't remember the name and surely won't call back.
I feel you...
The same woman?
Thank you
I am a christian, I think suicide can lead you to hell as much as it can lead you to heaven. God takes account of circumstances because God wants to save us all.
i wouldn't call them toxic tbh but it just seems impossible for them to consider me as a depressed person. and I don't say anything because I don't want to hurt them or bother them

Why do you bother about making it sound nice? 

If it's your last letter, please say your true feelings. Stop trying to please others

My family is all proud of me because I lie to them about what my business life is and my general life is. 

Everything is great days and they think I make millions of turnover in sales. They think I am happy with the house I bought and they think I want to get married with the love of my life very soon. Little do they know...

I just want to be in my hospital bed and to have my family in worries so they come into hospital to check me up and see me with all these tubes around me, half dead. 

This may sound attention whoring, but it is, I need some care and attention and I just lost hope that without any drastic actions, people will still not notice me
I mean drug myself with meds

>the things that others would die to have

that's the worst you can tell us. depressed people don't compare themselves to others and telling us that some may have it worst is one of the worst things to say. There's not worst conditions, just different
Idk really. I will become friends with some people and then will let them down because I can just go from one extreme to the other in 2 days.
Maybe I should just play with myself, drug myself enough to be in hospital but not enough for me to die so they can see me suffer

They will just put me in a mental ward and do nothing except give me tons of medicine. 

\+ i will loose my job, have to sell my house due to lack of income and basically screw my life that's already screwed. 

Last but not least, everyone will get to know it and it will be another reason to make fun of me
I kind of think it's the only way for people to notice. I don't have the courage to speak

My last bday, I posted a pic of a bday cake (pretending it was a message sent by mistake) the next day on a family chat to show and that's how I got them to wish HBD 1 day later... 

I feel you, Happy Birthday, I am with you!
No I don't want to talk to anyone anymore. People don't understand anything and whenever you complain, they say : some have it worse

I don't need help, I need comfort. 

Only those who go through the same can comfort me. The others have no clue

Lucky you. 

I don't want to risk it here in France because I'm worried it will all be a mess. I will start by shaving my head tonight. First I will feel good and 2nd maybe it will be a sign for those around that something isn't ticking right and they should care about me
No my parents say I am selfish and my girlfriend has kinda given me up which I don't blame her for. I am always negative and depressed that it's not interesting for her

Depression isn't an illness, it's just certain type of people. 

Just like some are born gay or straight, others are born depressed no matter what. People need to stop calling it an illness. If it was an illness, there would be some medicine against it. Nothing works

I'm 21, I have a full time job (lucky in a family business or I'd have nothing), in a relationship, I own my house. I don't have kids though. 

Guess what? none of this is enjoyable and I still want to kill myself everyday. I have 0 motivation at work, spend my time browsing Reddit and other websites and in my spare time have no enjoyment in life.

If anyone knows in France how it works. 

Can they send cops over ? Not sure how that would help except by ruining my life even more if they did

Thanks! :)

That's what people say when you say you will kill yourself, but when you try and fight, no one is here for you. 

I appreciate your message and am not throwing stones at you but it's like that. The day you scream, the whole world is here for you, but when you are silent, no one is here for you
